What this supports

The report records limited assurance over its defined Statement of Institutional Claims using the Board-adopted criteria specified in the report.

Scope & limits

Limited assurance is different from reasonable assurance. Outcome-study figures, ratings and financial statements fall outside the described scope; the report does not independently validate clinical efficacy.

The report is marked private/confidential and restricted-use. Its full text is not republished here; permitted circulation should be confirmed before a public evidence-room release.
